decisions.reason: As an already well-accepted trommel screen that appears to have remained in the portfolio for several years, it is likely above aspiration and should be retained.
The multi-model mobile flail shredder line fits the firm's core mobile processing business, and continued market presence suggests performance is satisfactory enough to keep.
Although initially less prominently presented, the mobile high-speed grinder line has had time to prove itself and likely merits continuation unless results now clearly fall below aspiration.
The stationary electric fine shredder remains somewhat more niche and uncertain, but it matches the firm's strategic move toward resource-saving stationary solutions and is worth keeping.
The stationary single-shaft pre-shredder line shows strong capability fit and sustained offering, so a German machinery firm would typically continue it rather than reallocate the resources.
